text:
maya_fin: Heads up — Peregrine Labs (acct PL-3387) has 3 outstanding invoices totalling $47,300. Oldest is 45 days past due. Collections vendor DM'ed that client says portal was locked after 'suspicious activity' and they want to push an ACH from a new bank account. Client also claims a $2,300 usage overcharge on invoice 2024-07-02 and is asking for a one-time credit. They're hinting at legal counsel if we force collections. @ajay_ops @sara_sales can we triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240702 ($21,500), INV-20240601 ($15,800), INV-20240510 ($10,000). Last recorded payment: $5,000 on 2024-04-05. Status: PAST_DUE. Collections vendor: Active outreach started 2024-08-12.

ajay_ops: Need to verify new ACH origin before unlocking portal. We require company bank letter + voided check or micro-deposit verification. Also any provisional credit we apply should be logged as 'disputed' in GL.

jordan_support: I can open a temporary unlock window for 60 minutes once finance signs off and we have the docs. Workflow I will follow: create support ticket, run KYC check, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=PL-3387 --window=60m --by=jordan_support`. Please upload docs to the secure intake link: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (client can't DM files).

sara_sales: Given the legal noise, proposing a short payment plan to de-escalate: 50% now ($23,650) then remaining balance split over 3 months. If Finance is okay, I'll pitch this to them and stall collections. Also they asked for the $2.3k credit — any appetite to provisionally credit while we reconcile?

maya_fin: They already paid $5k but dispute $2.3k usage charge. I can provisionally mark $2.3k as disputed, but we need approval for a provisional credit to keep them from spinning up counsel. Could we do a temporary credit of $2.3k and require reconciliation within 14 days?

ajay_ops: Finance policy: up to $2,000 provisional credit can be applied by finance ops. Anything above $2,000 requires sign-off from Lina (CFO) because it affects AR reserve. This is borderline. Also note, unlocking portal for a new ACH source requires support + risk approval.

lina_cfo: Quick decision: approve a one-time provisional credit of $2,300 to smooth this, conditional on signed acknowledgement that we will reconcile within 14 days. Approve temporary portal unlock (60m) after KYC docs are verified. No long-term payment deferrals without signed payment plan and collections hold. Please add a note to the account: "PROV_CREDIT_2300_LINA_2024-08-13".

jordan_support: Got it. I'll create ticket SB-91234, request the docs, and stand by to run the unlock once docs are in. I'll also pause the next scheduled collections outreach until 2024-08-20 per Lina's note.

sara_sales: I'll contact the client now, propose the 60m window for ACH upload + the provisional credit + ask them to sign the 14-day reconciliation acknowledgement. I'll CC collections so they hold off.

maya_fin: Perfect — I'll prepare the provisional credit entry and update GL after we get the signed ack. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
